//go:build e2e && svc_agents_orchestrator

package tests

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"

	agentsv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/agents/v1"
	llmv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/llm/v1"
	runnerv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/runner/v1"
	threadsv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/threads/v1"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)

// restrictedHoldWindow keeps one answered task Pod alive for the host-side
// watcher (.github/e2e/restricted-network.py), which checks its shape,
// privileges and network from outside the suite.
const restrictedHoldWindow = 5 * time.Minute

// Injected only into the explicit-proxy E2E leg, whose runner builds
// restricted Pods with an empty capability allowlist. A caller asking the
// runner directly for the old tunneler's NET_ADMIN is refused before any
// Secret, PVC or Pod exists, so nothing can be inspected afterwards.
func TestRestrictedRunnerRefusesNetAdmin(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	client := runnerv1.NewRunnerServiceClient(dialRunnerGRPC(t, runnerAddr))
	workloadID := uuid.NewString()
	_, err := client.StartWorkload(ctx, &runnerv1.StartWorkloadRequest{
		WorkloadId: workloadID,
		Main:       &runnerv1.ContainerSpec{Name: "main", Image: "alpine:3.21", Cmd: []string{"sleep", "1"}},
		InitContainers: []*runnerv1.ContainerSpec{{
			Name:                 "ziti-sidecar",
			Image:                "alpine:3.21",
			Cmd:                  []string{"sleep", "1"},
			RequiredCapabilities: []string{"NET_ADMIN"},
			AdditionalProperties: map[string]string{"restart_policy": "Always"},
		}},
	})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != "required_capability_not_allowed: NET_ADMIN" {
		t.Fatalf("NET_ADMIN start: got %v, want InvalidArgument required_capability_not_allowed: NET_ADMIN", err)
	}
	_, err = client.InspectWorkload(ctx, &runnerv1.InspectWorkloadRequest{WorkloadId: workloadID})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound {
		t.Fatalf("refused workload %s must not exist: %v", workloadID, err)
	}
	t.Logf("runner refused NET_ADMIN for %s and created nothing", workloadID)
}

// One real turn through the explicit-proxy overlay under restricted Pod
// Security, then the Pod is held -- the agent is not deleted -- so the
// watcher checks a live, enrolled Pod rather than one being torn down.
func TestRestrictedTaskPodAnswersAndHolds(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), responseWaitTimeout+restrictedHoldWindow+5*time.Minute)
	// Registered first so it runs last: the cleanups below use this context.
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	agentsClient := agentsv1.NewAgentsServiceClient(dialGRPC(t, agentsAddr))
	threadsClient := threadsv1.NewThreadsServiceClient(dialGRPC(t, threadsAddr))
	runnerClient := runnerv1.NewRunnerServiceClient(dialRunnerGRPC(t, runnerAddr))
	setup := newWorkflowGatewaySetup(t, ctx)
	orgID := setup.OrganizationID
	modelID := createWorkflowGatewayModel(t, setup, testLLMEndpointCodex, llmv1.Protocol_PROTOCOL_RESPONSES, "simple-hello")
	environmentID := newSuiteEnvironment(t, setup.Context, agentsClient, orgID, codexRuntime, "alpine:3.21")
	name := fmt.Sprintf("e2e-restricted-hold-%s", uuid.NewString())
	agent := createAgentWithOptions(t, setup.Context, agentsClient, agentCreateOptions{
		Name: name, Nickname: nicknameFor(name), Model: modelID, OrganizationID: orgID, EnvironmentID: environmentID,
	})
	agentID := agent.GetMeta().GetId()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cleanupAgentEnvs(t, setup.Context, agentsClient, orgID, agentID)
		deleteAgent(t, setup.Context, agentsClient, orgID, agentID)
	})
	createAgentEnv(t, setup.Context, agentsClient, agentID, "LLM_API_TOKEN", setup.Token)
	thread := createThread(t, setup.Context, threadsClient, orgID, []string{setup.IdentityID, agentID})
	threadID := thread.GetId()
	t.Cleanup(func() { archiveThread(t, setup.Context, threadsClient, threadID) })
	labels := map[string]string{labelManagedBy: managedByValue, labelAgentID: agentID, labelThreadID: threadID}
	sent := sendMessage(t, setup.Context, threadsClient, threadID, setup.IdentityID, "hello")
	responseCtx, responseCancel := context.WithTimeout(setup.Context, responseWaitTimeout)
	defer responseCancel()
	body, err := pollForAgentResponse(t, responseCtx, threadsClient, runnerClient, orgID, threadID, agentID, labels, messageCreatedAt(t, sent), expectedAgentResponse)
	if err != nil || body != expectedAgentResponse {
		t.Fatalf("restricted task Pod did not answer: %q %v", body, err)
	}
	ids, err := findWorkloadsByLabels(ctx, runnerClient, labels)
	if err != nil || len(ids) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("answered, but its workload is not listed: %v", err)
	}
	t.Logf("agent %s answered through workload %v; holding %s for the restricted network watcher", agentID, ids, restrictedHoldWindow)
	select {
	case <-time.After(restrictedHoldWindow):
	case <-ctx.Done():
	}
}
